connection.notReady: Connect and identify the device to calibrate

prepare.title: Prepare
prepare.description: Fix the sensor at a height of 20 mm to 30 mm, prepare the calibration materials, then click Start Calibration to enter the calibration steps.

white.title: Capture base color
white.description: Place the base color underneath, then click Start Capture.

black.title: Capture line color
black.description: Place the line color underneath, then click Start Capture.

blackFirstHalf.title: Capture left 4 line-color channels
blackFirstHalf.description: Place the line color underneath, then start capturing the left 4 channels.

blackSecondHalf.title: Capture right 4 line-color channels
blackSecondHalf.description: Place the line color underneath, then start capturing the right 4 channels.

save.title: Save
save.description: Confirm the captured result, then save it to Flash.

confirmSave.title: Confirm saving calibration data
confirmSave.content: Saving will overwrite calibration data in device Flash.

file.title: Firmware file
file.subtitle: Select a .bin firmware package, enter upgrade mode, then start upgrading.

enterDialog.title: Confirm entering upgrade mode
enterDialog.content: The device will switch to upgrade mode and disconnect serial automatically. Reconnect serial after it finishes, then start upgrading.

exitDialog.title: Confirm exiting upgrade mode
exitDialog.content: If the upgrade has not started, the device will return to normal mode and disconnect serial. The device will reject exit if an upgrade has started or the app image is invalid.

completeDialog.title: Upgrade complete
completeDialog.content: Firmware upgrade is complete and serial has disconnected. Reconnect serial to continue using the device.

startDialog.title: Confirm firmware upgrade
startDialog.content: Do not disconnect or power off during upgrade.

forceRiskDialog.title: Confirm forced upgrade
forceRiskDialog.content: A forced upgrade is risky. The firmware may not match this hardware. Proceed with caution.

serial.unsupported: Serial connection is not supported in this environment

firmware.normalModeRequired: Only normal mode can enter upgrade mode
firmware.exitRejected: The device cannot safely exit upgrade mode. Upgrade the firmware again.
